gen-dafont-oldtimer-fs-amulya: Oldtimer draws its round forms like open parentheses, smooth as bent wire and commanding without any brushy swell on the downstrokes. Amulya, a modern sans, keeps its curves generously gapped for easy going.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-fs-spline-sans: Round, wiry and classic. Oldtimer has a presence that Spline Sans, a plain sans with wide gaps between curve ends and stems, deliberately lets stand alone.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-outfit: Outfit reads clean and friendly, its curves stopping short of closing. Oldtimer's open-parenthesis rounds give the pair a commanding, classic front that the softer body never fights.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans is built from a single monoline stroke, with curve endings held well apart and a precise, modern feel. And Oldtimer's round, swell-free display forms supply the classic authority that sits above it.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-sora: Sora reads precise and geometric, its c and s kept widely parted with no pressure swell at the corners. But Oldtimer is the one built to command, with round forms like open parentheses.
gen-dafont-origami-fs-alpino: Alpino reads cozy and casual, its tall body making the ascenders look short. Origami does the attention-grabbing with a brush-like single stroke, while Alpino quietly handles the sentences.
gen-dafont-origami-fs-nunito: Nunito reads approachable and contemporary, with big round lowercase bowls and terminals that finish well clear of the stem. Origami's tube-like strokes can go larger.
gen-dafont-origami-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Warm and neutral, Pilcrow Rounded packs its tall lowercase tightly, with big counters and curves that refuse to close, against Origami's sign-painter single-stroke look. Give the sans a little extra size.
gen-dafont-origami-fs-quicksand: Origami has the look of a sign-painter's single brush stroke, lead-heavy in its lowercase and unique at a glance. And Quicksand answers with tall, bulb-like bowls and bars of identical thickness, approachable and neutral.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-hind: Hind keeps its lowercase close to the capitals and its strokes steady like a drawn string, neutral and professional throughout. Outrun Future brings the synthwave authority, widely spaced and outlined.
